title: Canyon & Blue Hole Adventure

overview.description: Your journey begins with a comfortable air-conditioned van pickup from your hotel, followed by a two-hour drive to the breathtaking Coloured Canyon. Located 10 km south of Dahab, this deep desert oasis offers a truly unique experience.

coloured_canyon: Spend 45 minutes walking through the stunning canyon.
Enjoy the spectacular rock formations and their extraordinary colors.
In winter, witness water oozing from the cracks in the mountains.
camel_ride: After a 45-minute drive to Dahab city, embark on a 20-minute camel ride along the beautiful shoreline of the Aqaba Gulf.
Marvel at the crystal-clear waters of the Red Sea as you ride.
snorkeling_blue_hole: Prepare for an unforgettable 45-minute snorkeling experience at the famous Blue Hole, one of the world’s best spots for diving and snorkeling.
lunch_relaxation: After snorkeling, unwind in a Bedouin tent by the sea.
Enjoy a delicious lunch with stunning seaside views (drinks not included).
shopping_dahab: End your adventure with a visit to Dahab’s bazaar, where you can explore local markets and shop for souvenirs.
After shopping, you’ll be driven back to your hotel.

highlights: The Coloured Canyon – Unique rock formations & breathtaking views
Camel Riding – Scenic ride along the Aqaba Gulf shoreline
The Blue Hole – World-class snorkeling & marine beauty
Lunch by the Sea – Traditional meal in a Bedouin tent
Shopping in Dahab – Explore the local bazaar

excludes: Snorkeling equipment (available for rent at an extra charge)

optional_add_ons: Quad biking for 30 minutes (available at an extra charge)
important_notes: The trip is not suitable for those who cannot walk long distances.
Tailor-made private tours and packages are available for larger groups upon request.

recommended_to_bring: Sport shoes or trainers (for comfortable walking in the canyon)
Snorkeling equipment (if you have your own)
